batch_rename.title: Batch rename
batch_rename.description: Analyze every selected file with AI and propose consistent, individually editable names, without templates or naming rules. Preview and validate before renaming, without overwriting.
batch_rename.when_to_offer: Several regular files selected in Finder.
batch_rename.when_to_avoid: Duplicate target names or existing target files.

calculate.title: Calculate
calculate.description: Open a numeric expression editor with immediate local calculation.
calculate.when_to_offer: A number or arithmetic expression selected for further calculation.
calculate.when_to_avoid: Prose, dates or identifiers mistaken for numbers.

change_case.title: Change case
change_case.description: Change letter case locally using an explicit lower, upper or title choice.
change_case.when_to_offer: Text whose capitalization the user wants to change.
change_case.when_to_avoid: Code and case-sensitive identifiers, or numeric-only content.

check_claim.title: Check a claim
check_claim.description: Verify a factual claim against web evidence with a short verdict and linked sources.
check_claim.when_to_avoid: An opinion, private personal statement, code or request to merely fix prose.

clean_formatting.title: Clean formatting
clean_formatting.description: Clean redundant prose spacing locally while preserving useful structure and code.
clean_formatting.when_to_offer: Pasted prose with repeated spaces, invisible characters or redundant blank lines.
clean_formatting.when_to_avoid: Intentional indentation, tables or code needing those spaces.

convert_currencies.title: Convert currencies
convert_currencies.description: Convert an amount using a chosen currency pair and dated ECB reference rate.
convert_currencies.when_to_offer: A selected amount, explicit currency or currency symbol; source currency is confirmed when ambiguous.
convert_currencies.when_to_avoid: A date, account identifier, multiple amounts or live-trading expectations.

convert_time_zones.title: Convert time zones
convert_time_zones.description: Resolve the source zone and date, then show the same instant in the Mac time zone.
convert_time_zones.when_to_offer: A clock time with a recognized time zone.
convert_time_zones.when_to_avoid: Time with no zone, invalid time or impossible/repeated DST wall time.

convert_units.title: Convert units
convert_units.description: Convert one selected quantity locally, with explicit resolution of ambiguous source units.
convert_units.when_to_offer: A number followed by a recognized distance, weight, temperature, volume or speed unit.
convert_units.when_to_avoid: Multiple quantities, unclear separators or unrelated text.

directions.title: Get directions
directions.description: Resolve a selected address and open directions to the user-chosen destination in Apple Maps.
directions.when_to_offer: An address the user may want to travel to.
directions.when_to_avoid: Numbers alone, code or unrelated prose.

event_plan.title: Add to Calendar
event_plan.description: Prepare scheduled Apple Calendar event drafts for review before saving.
event_plan.when_to_offer: A selected meeting, appointment or visit with a concrete schedule.
event_plan.when_to_avoid: Task deadlines alone, cancelled events, or speculative plans.

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: Give a short explanation, defining a term in its observed surrounding context when available.
explain.when_to_offer: An unfamiliar term or passage needing understanding; use the observed nearby excerpt to disambiguate the selected term.
explain.when_to_avoid: Content the user wants to send or an explicit request to translate.

extract_tasks.title: Extract tasks
extract_tasks.description: List explicitly pending work with quoted owners and deadlines; creates no external items.
extract_tasks.when_to_offer: A message or document containing concrete requests or commitments.
extract_tasks.when_to_avoid: Completed work, vague possibilities or an appointment without work.

fix.title: Correct
fix.description: Fix spelling and grammatical forms word by word without rewriting.
fix.when_to_offer: Clear spelling, accent, conjugation or agreement errors in prose.
fix.when_to_avoid: Intentional slang, correct prose, code, numbers alone.

improve_prompt.title: Improve prompt
improve_prompt.description: Turn a rough request for an AI into a clear, actionable prompt without answering it.
improve_prompt.when_to_offer: A selected instruction, draft prompt or request intended for an AI; vague task descriptions that need context, constraints or output structure.
improve_prompt.when_to_avoid: Ordinary messages needing a reply, factual passages needing explanation, already precise prompts needing no change, or requests to execute the task directly.

key_points.title: Key points
key_points.description: Extract up to three essential ideas in the source language.
key_points.when_to_offer: A substantive passage with several important ideas to retain.
key_points.when_to_avoid: Very short messages, code or material with no distinct ideas.

move_files.title: Move files
move_files.description: Choose a folder or a recent destination, then move the selected files after validation. Recent folder paths remain on this Mac.
move_files.when_to_avoid: Missing or symbolic-link destinations, unavailable files, filename collisions.

open_maps.title: Open in Maps
open_maps.description: Resolve a selected address or place and let the user choose a location to open in Apple Maps.
open_maps.when_to_offer: A street address or named place.
open_maps.when_to_avoid: Code, URLs, long prose, or no clear location.

rename_file.title: Rename
rename_file.description: Analyze file contents with AI, preview an editable meaningful name and preserve the extension. Rename only after explicit validation.
rename_file.when_to_offer: One regular file selected in Finder.
rename_file.when_to_avoid: Unavailable cloud files, directories and symbolic links.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: Draft a response to an incoming message using a user-selected intention.
reply.when_to_offer: A meaningful incoming message inviting a response.
reply.when_to_avoid: An outgoing draft to correct, a code dump, or isolated values.

rewrite.title: Rewrite
rewrite.description: Improve phrasing while preserving meaning, with a user-chosen register.
rewrite.when_to_offer: Awkward prose or a message that needs clearer phrasing.
rewrite.when_to_avoid: A bare number, code, or a request only for spelling correction.

shop.title: Shop
shop.description: Find products to buy for a need mentioned in selected text, with optional preferences and verified product links.
shop.when_to_offer: A purchase need, replacement, product recommendation or comparison; the user needs an item, including an informal message about buying equipment or a gift.
shop.when_to_avoid: Non-shopping passages, text editing, stock investments, purchases of illegal or regulated goods, or requests to place an order.

simplify.title: Simplify
simplify.description: Replace jargon and complex wording with clear everyday language.
simplify.when_to_offer: Dense prose, specialist terminology or complicated sentences.
simplify.when_to_avoid: Already simple messages, code or isolated numbers.

summarize_file.title: Summarize
summarize_file.description: Explain one image, PDF, Word document, spreadsheet or presentation in a concise reading card. Office files are converted to PDF locally before the existing explicit AI upload; the original file and its path are not uploaded.
summarize_file.when_to_offer: One downloaded image/PDF or supported office document selected in Finder, with readable contents.
summarize_file.when_to_avoid: Unsupported formats, locked files, or a prepared PDF exceeding 4 MB or 30 pages.

task_plan.title: Create tasks
task_plan.description: Prepare source-backed Apple Reminders drafts for review before saving.
task_plan.when_to_offer: Explicit pending work, assignments or promises worth saving as reminders.
task_plan.when_to_avoid: Completed or cancelled work, speculative ideas, or scheduled meetings alone.

tone.title: Adjust tone
tone.description: Change a message to a warm, direct or diplomatic tone while keeping its stance.
tone.when_to_offer: A message whose tone could be adapted for its recipient.
tone.when_to_avoid: Facts needing explanation, code, or no communicative message.

translate.title: Translate
translate.description: Translate into an explicitly chosen language while preserving tone and details.
translate.when_to_offer: Foreign-language prose or content the user wants in another language.
translate.when_to_avoid: Code, isolated numbers or prose already in the desired language.
